River lines come from the USGS National Hydrography Dataset (NHD).

```{python}
import requests
import geopandas as gpd

url = "https://hydro.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/nhd/MapServer/6/query"
params = {
    "where": "GNIS_NAME IN ('Puyallup River','Carbon River')",
    "geometry": "-122.30,46.98,-122.10,47.20",
    "geometryType": "esriGeometryEnvelope",
    "inSR": 4326,
    "outFields": "GNIS_NAME",
    "outSR": 4326,
    "f": "geojson",
}
r = requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=60)
rivers = gpd.GeoDataFrame.from_features(r.json()["features"], crs=4326)
rivers.head()
```
```{python}
rivers.explore(column="gnis_name", tiles="Esri.WorldImagery")
```
```{python}
from shapely.ops import linemerge

rivers = rivers.explode(index_parts=False)

def in_reach(row):
    xs, ys = row.geometry.xy
    if row.gnis_name == "Puyallup River":
        return min(ys) >= 47.055 and max(ys) <= 47.1315
    else:
        return min(xs) >= -122.2335 and max(xs) <= -122.17

reach = rivers[rivers.apply(in_reach, axis=1)]
centerlines = reach.dissolve(by="gnis_name").reset_index()
centerlines["geometry"] = centerlines.geometry.apply(linemerge)
centerlines
```
```{python}
from shapely.geometry import Polygon

lines_m = centerlines.to_crs(2856)
print((lines_m.length / 1000).round(1))

buffers = {"Puyallup River": 1000, "Carbon River": 600}
pieces = [geom.buffer(buffers[name]) for name, geom in zip(lines_m.gnis_name, lines_m.geometry)]

shape = pieces[0].union(pieces[1])
shape = shape.buffer(300).buffer(-300)
shape = Polygon(shape.exterior)

corridor = gpd.GeoDataFrame({"name": ["study corridor"]}, geometry=[shape], crs=2856)
print(f"Corridor area: {corridor.area.iloc[0] / 1e6:.1f} km²")
```
```{python}
centerlines.to_file("data/reach/centerlines.geojson", driver="GeoJSON")
corridor.to_crs(4326).to_file("data/reach/corridor.geojson", driver="GeoJSON")
```

```{python}
m = corridor.explore(color="steelblue", style_kwds={"fillOpacity": 0.15}, tiles="Esri.WorldImagery")
centerlines.explore(m=m, column="gnis_name")
m.save("reach_map.html")
```
